svg.title: Contribution arcade | WallfacerX
svg.desc: 437 real contributions from 2025-10-26 to 2026-10-30. A yellow Pac-Man-style character turns active day squares violet. A white ghost starts halfway through and catches him at the final square. This is a separate visualization of GitHub data.
